fields.description:
# PL-5: Ban Status + Banner (simplified)

_Simplified ban handling on the Player record — a manual status flip plus a top-of-record banner, with no persisted restriction-detail fields._

### FIELDS

* Player Status — Picklist (existing field, already covered under PL-1/BUILD-173)

* Set to Banned manually by Ops. No separate ban-reason fields get persisted on the Player record.

* Ban Banner — Page component, not a stored field

* Shown at the top of the record when Player Status = Banned, e.g. "This player is banned — see Sign Ups for details."

### IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS

* Do not build the Restriction Detail fields

* Restriction Reason, Restricted On, Open Sign Ups Flagged, Payouts Placed on Hold, Restriction Notes — confirmed cut, Joyce/Kobi, 08/18: "so those fields, are we saying like we don't need those like restriction detail fields for now?" — "Correct."

* Restriction reasoning is inferred from Sign Ups already flagged for fraud

* Not re-typed on the Player record — Joyce, 08/18: "the goal was that it would be, like, inferred from the signups that were flagged for fraud... I think it just says banned, and then... some banner that says, like, see signups for more details."

* Banner text should point to Sign Ups for details, not store a reason on Player

* Confirms the banner is informational only — no new field backs it.

### NOTES

* Provenance: PL-5 (Player Record User Stories doc).
* Open question carried from the doc: whether the Ban action modal should still capture a Ban Reason + required Notes at the moment of banning, now that persistent fields are cut — not re-confirmed in the transcript. Flag before building PL-6 (Ban Automation).
* Also depends on the Sign Up, Redeposit, and Payout objects existing (per the story map) — no Asana tickets for those yet.

### SOURCE

* [Taryn doc PL-5 — Player Record User Stories](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1OSqt7ilS1feVS7aVxAYSsBZIcTrc1J31_WnQiVucEJg/edit)
* [Aug 18 Weekly Sync — Joyce Kiddell, 1:25:27 (restriction detail inferred from flagged Sign Ups, not re-typed on Player)](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=5127)
* [Aug 18 Weekly Sync — Kobi Kunasekaran, 1:28:00 (“Correct” — persistent Restriction Detail fields cut)](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=5280)
* Dependencies: [BUILD-173 — Player: Core Details fields](https://app.asana.com/1/1202721605677544/project/1215732799516730/task/1217684264652851)
* Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer
* Remember to update the requirements documentation as part of this change.
* Created 2026-08-20 from Player record documentation review.

comments.body:
**Addition:**

Added the Inactive Banner (90-Days per Emily) & Pending Banner alongside Banned banner. All have Player Status filtering not yet logic tied to each

Built per spec: Ban Banner component added to the page, using a Component Visibility filter for Player Status = Banned, with banner text pointing to Sign Ups for details (informational only — no new field stores a reason on Player, per spec). A blank Restriction Detail field section was added to the layout, shown only when Player Status = Banned. Per spec, the actual Restriction Detail fields (Restriction Reason, Restricted On, Open Sign Ups Flagged, Payouts Placed on Hold, Restriction Notes) are confirmed cut and were not built. Automation/logic tying banner display to status changes is not yet built — flagging this as outstanding, not done.
